# Maintained native resource sources

Rust source, build script, upstream README and licenses are exact Trust
`8e3adfc1df7bb0fa79b129a9f20df4fadad52143`, `crates/trust-resource-provenance`.
The manifest redirects dependencies to maintained local crates.

Resolver query role 5 is distinct from metadata role 3 and Mach-O linker role 4.
Protocol data and the resolver support marker create no admission, SDK,
CPU, memory, execution, retirement or proof authority. Actual custody remains
with the native host and the original retained client owner.

The workload helper retains the independently selected original Store directory
by child-only descriptor handoff. Its new entry never falls back to account
discovery. Original helper wait observations remain separate from hosted-target
metrics and grant no admission or release authority. This exact source pin is
reachable from canonical Trust main `0cfb55c1bc60a8ae7499bb2a4dbad8cee2b8d1b1`.
